high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "tharman.sg." The post was made 14 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The profile picture shows two individuals, presumably Tharman Shanmugaratnam and his wife, as indicated by the verified badge. The main content of the post features a formal meeting between two individuals, a man and a woman, shaking hands on a red carpet. They are standing in front of a building with classical architecture, characterized by large arches and columns.
